{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is negative or neutral).",
    "Adjust downward for persistent negative sentiment, as models tend to overreact to pessimism.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias when price deviates >15% from recent 5-day average, especially in low-sentiment periods.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is negative and price is trending upward (contrarian signal).",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early forecast windows (1-3 days) when sentiment is positive — model tends to overestimate short-term gains.",
    "Apply upward correction if sentiment turns positive after a prolonged downtrend (e.g., >3 days of negative sentiment).",
    "Use sentiment as a filter: if sentiment > 0.2, reduce forecast volatility; if sentiment < -0.2, increase downward bias."
  ]
}
